rules.statement: A person acting on the orders of another may not generally be free from liability for breach of the rule, but in this case, the accused showed sufficient grounds for exemption due to their bona fide belief that they were felling timber on their master's property.
rules.supporting_quote: "The same remark applies to Slema Lebbe, the third accused. At all events, any bona fide claim of title on the part of Mohamadu Usoof ought to benefit them."
